name: Amplitude
description: Read charts, funnels and the tracking plan of the Amplitude projects you can access. Read-only: tools that can also change Amplitude are not allowed.

sources.claim: Endpoints: US https://mcp.amplitude.com/mcp, EU https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp; the URL must match the data region. Transport: Streamable HTTP. Authentication: OAuth 2.0.

Tools listed here only retrieve or query (their descriptions: search content, find taxonomy, run ad-hoc queries, retrieve chart definitions and data, retrieve the object behind a URL, return AI Context). Tools named use_* or manage_* can also change Amplitude and are left out (#52).
Dynamic client registration (registration_endpoint), PKCE S256, a revocation endpoint, and scopes all:read, all:write, offline_access.
